claims: Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II mission features a four-person crew—Reid Wiseman (Commander), Victor Glover (Pilot), Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen (Mission Specialists).
Artemis II crew is on a 10-day journey around the Moon.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight test of the SLS rocket.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight test of the Orion spacecraft.
Artemis II includes the first woman to venture into deep space.
Artemis II includes the first Black person to venture into deep space.
Artemis II includes the first Canadian to venture into deep space.
Reid Wiseman is a NASA astronaut.
Reid Wiseman is a Navy veteran.
Reid Wiseman previously served as Chief of the Astronaut Office.
Victor Glover is a NASA astronaut.
Victor Glover piloted the SpaceX Crew-1 mission.
Victor Glover is the first Black person to go to the Moon.
Christina Koch is a NASA astronaut.
Christina Koch holds the record for the longest single spaceflight by a woman.
Christina Koch is the first woman to fly to the Moon.
Jeremy Hansen is a Canadian Space Agency (CSA) astronaut.
Jeremy Hansen is a former fighter pilot.
Jeremy Hansen is the first Canadian to travel to the Moon.
Artemis II mission objectives include validating the Orion spacecraft's life support systems with a crew aboard.
Artemis II mission objectives include validating the Orion spacecraft's performance with a crew aboard.
Artemis II crew will fly around the Moon.
Artemis II crew is aboard the Integrity capsule.
Integrity capsule launched from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida on April 1, 2026.
